# Kodac Solutions
Kodac Solutions is a full-service digital agency specializing in scaling businesses through high-performance marketing and development services.

## Core Services

### SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
We help businesses rank on the first page of search results.
- [SEO Services](/services/seo): Comprehensive strategy including technical audits, keyword research, link building, and content optimization.

### Social Media Management
Build and engage your audience across platforms.
- Strategy development, content creation, community management, and growth analytics for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

### Video Editing
Professional, high-conversion video production.
- Services include editing for promotional ads, social media shorts, long-form content, and corporate branding.

### Web Development
Custom, high-speed, and responsive web solutions.
- Specialization in Next.js, React, and TypeScript. We build performant, SEO-friendly websites tailored to business goals.

### Ads Campaigns
Data-driven paid media strategies.
- Management of Google Ads and Meta Ads to ensure high ROI and lead generation.

## Why Choose Us?
- Data-driven strategies tailored to your niche.
- Focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO) and ROI.
- Technical expertise combined with creative design.
